reply_text:
I've answered Tobias in a thread under his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

On 3 Sep 2025, Priyanka posted in that channel that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had unlabelled totes stacked beside door 4. At 18:43 that day she wrote that the incident was resolved and Southgate had cleared the backlog.

That channel doesn't give an address or site ID for Southgate, and I couldn't find a shared Tansley account file that does. I told him so and suggested he ask Priyanka for the full site details.

To answer, I only read that incident channel (I checked first that Tobias is a member) and the shared files. I didn't use gbrain or message search, because their results include conversations Tobias can't see.
